title: CENTRALE LYON - Doctorat Modélisation prédictive de matériaux polymères recyclés par inférence statistique et apprentissage machine hybride.
description: Contexte Le projet MIAM, soutenu par l’Institut Carnot Ingé nierie@Lyon , propose une thèse de doctorat de 36 mois au sein du Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes (LTDS UMR CNRS 5513, Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Ecully, France). Ce travail de recherche s’inscrit dans une collaboration étroite entre les équipes DySCo du LTDS et les laboratoires partenaires comme le LAMCOS (INSA de Lyon) et du Centre Technique Industriel (CTI) de la Plasturgie et des Composites français (IPC). L’objectif scientifique est de lever les verrous liés à la variabilité des matières plastiques recyclées en développant des stratégies d’apprentissage machine et d’inférence statistique capables de garantir une qualité de 1 production stable malgré l’hétérogénéité des gisements de matériaux. Le cœur des travaux portera sur le développement d’une structure d’apprentissage originale permettant de fusionner des données expérimentales réelles avec des données synthétiques issues de simulations numériques. Le candidat devra concevoir des modèles prédictifs robustes, souvent qualifiés de jumeaux numériques, pour assurer un pilotage des procédés en temps réel. Cette approche vise à réduire drastiquement les délais de mise en œuvre de nouveaux matériaux innovants tout en maintenant une fidélité physique stricte, assurant ainsi que les modèles ne soient pas de simples corrélations statistiques mais reflètent la réalité mécanique. Cas d’étude Le cas d’application principal retenu pour cette recherche est le développement d’un capteur virtuel appliqué à la rhéologie au sein des lignes de transformation de l’IPC. En instrumentant les étapes de mélange et d’injection, le doctorant cherchera à prédire les propriétés finales de la matière, telles que la viscosité et le comportement des granulés, en fonction des réglages machines. Ce cas offre un terrain d’étude idéal pour tester la résilience des algorithmes face à des conditions de production changeantes. Profil recherché Le profil recherché pour cette thèse est celui d’un candidat possédant une double compétence affirmée en intelligence artificielle et en modélisation physique des matériaux. Une maîtrise des outils de programmation et une sensibilité aux problématiques industrielles sont indispensables pour mener à bien les missions de ce projet. Les travaux se dérouleront principalement à l’École Centrale de Lyon, avec des échanges réguliers entre les sites d’Écully, de Villeurbanne et d’Oyonnax, et bénéficieront d’un environnement scientifique de haut niveau dédié à l’innovation dans le domaine des matériaux et des procédés. Type de contrat Le contrat sera un CDD de type contrat doctoral ’avec activité (diffusion d’informations scientifiques et/ou expertise)’ géré par Centrale Lyon. La rémunération sera d’approximativement 2035€ net par mois sur 36 mois. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Notre ancrage en France est déjà un succès incontestable. Face à une demande qui explose et pour soutenir cette dynamique, nous passons à la vitesse supérieure et recherchons nos prochains leaders sur le marché français.

L'opportunité : Soyons clairs dès le départ

Ce poste n'est pas un poste de manager classique. Pendant les 6 premiers mois, tu es sur le terrain, en tant que commercial(e) à part entière avec des objectifs de vente individuels, comme chaque membre de l'équipe.

Pourquoi ? Parce que chez Salonkee, on ne peut diriger que ce que l'on maîtrise. Avant de coacher une équipe sur la prospection, les démos et le closing, tu dois connaître le marché, les salons et notre produit sur le bout des doigts. C'est notre garantie de qualité pour toi, pour ton équipe, et pour nos clients.

Si tu cherches un rôle de management à distance, derrière un tableau Excel, ce poste n'est pas fait pour toi. Si tu veux gagner ta légitimité sur le terrain avant de prendre les rênes, continue à lire.

Tes missions

Phase 1 : Tu vends.

  • Prospection terrain : Tu démarches activement les salons de coiffure et instituts de beauté de ta zone; porte-à-porte, démos en direct, closing.

  • Objectifs individuels : Tu portes les mêmes objectifs de vente qu'un(e) commercial(e) terrain. Ta performance est mesurée, suivie, et récompensée.

  • Apprentissage du marché : Tu comprends dans le détail les besoins des salons, les objections récurrentes et ce qui fait signer un·e gérant·e.

  • Maîtrise des outils : CRM impeccable, pipeline propre, reporting fiable; tu appliques ce que tu exigeras plus tard de ton équipe.

Phase 2 : Tu construis et tu diriges.

  • Constitution de ton équipe : Tu participes au recrutement et fais grandir ton équipe jusqu'à environ 5 personnes (et plus en cas de succès).

  • Lead by example : Tu passes plus de 80 % de ton temps sur le terrain avec ton équipe; tu accompagnes et tu coaches la prospection, tu assistes aux démos et tu aides activement à transformer les opportunités en signatures.

  • Structure & coaching : Tu organises la semaine, tu animes les 1:1 et les roleplays, tu lèves les obstacles rapidement et tu veilles à la rigueur du CRM de toute l'équipe.

  • Pilotage par les chiffres : Tu connais les indicateurs clés de chaque membre de ton équipe et tu pilotes activement la performance.

  • Culture & motivation : Tu crées des challenges d'équipe, tu renforces la culture sales et tu fais en sorte que chacun(e) progresse en continu.

Ton profil

  • Passion pour la vente terrain : Au moins 3 à 4 ans d'expérience en vente terrain / commerce itinérant (le B2B est un plus). Tu adores être en première ligne.

  • Potentiel de leadership : Tu n'as pas besoin d'avoir déjà été manager, mais tu as l'envie et le talent de prendre la responsabilité d'une région et de mener une équipe au succès.

  • Autonomie & sens stratégique : Tu planifies tes activités en toute autonomie, tu fixes des priorités claires et trouves des moyens intelligents d'implanter Salonkee dans ta région.

  • Affinité tech : Bonne compréhension des solutions digitales et solide expérience des CRM.

  • Mobilité : Permis B indispensable, Tu gères en totale autonomie la région de Strasbourg et alentours.

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales..

Ce que nous offrons

  • Rémunération attractive : Un fixe solide + des commissions non plafonnées; ta performance paie, dès le premier mois et à chaque étape.

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Un plan d'évolution transparent : Du terrain vers le leadership, avec des jalons définis dès ton arrivée.

  • Organisation autonome : Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • Mutuelle

  • Tickets-restaurant

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même.

Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité.

With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p>For clarity and accessibility, we have chosen not to use gender-neutral or inclusive writing conventions in our communications. WPP Media is firmly committed to diversity: we value inclusion and equality, considering all candidates regardless of gender identity, ethnic origin, or religion. All our positions are also open to people with disabilities.</p> <p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is a creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build a better future for our people, our planet, our clients, and our communities. For more information, visit&nbsp;<a id="menur2aq" class="fui-Link ___1q1shib f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1s184ao f1mk8lai fnbmjn9 f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn" href="https://wpp.com/" target="_blank">wpp.com</a>.</p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's global media network. For more information, visit&nbsp;<a id="menur2as" class="fui-Link ___1q1shib f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1s184ao f1mk8lai fnbmjn9 f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn" href="https://wppmedia.com/" target="_blank">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. To succeed in this role, it is crucial to embody the core values that unite WPP and WPP Media:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Extraordinary</strong>&nbsp;by fostering collective leadership that inspires truly transformative creativity.</li> <li><strong>Create an Open environment</strong>&nbsp;by finding the perfect balance between the fulfillment of our people and the satisfaction of our clients, all built on mutual trust.</li> <li><strong>Lead with Optimism</strong>&nbsp;by actively stimulating growth and development to mobilize our entire organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About EssenceMediacom</strong></p> <p>EssenceMediacom represents a new approach to the media agency. Our expertise is based on in-depth data analysis and a keen understanding of consumer behavior, combined with the most advanced technologies.</p> <p>We are convinced that the strategic alliance between media and creativity can radically transform the performance of the biggest brands. Our role is to support our clients in understanding the complex challenges of contemporary marketing and to identify the levers of innovation that will enable them to create lasting connections with their consumers.</p> <p>Our organizational structure reflects this modern vision: we combine intelligent data utilization with a human-centered approach, we cultivate diversity of perspectives and expertise, and we favor a continuous, large-scale experimentation and learning approach. Above all, we have integrated adaptability into our DNA to continuously evolve with market transformations.<br><br></p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>The&nbsp;<strong>Performance &amp; Analytics Manager – Europe</strong>&nbsp;will be a crucial member of our client-focused team for the&nbsp;<strong>Europe region</strong>, responsible for assisting in the planning, execution, and optimization of European digital acquisition campaigns and&nbsp;<strong>analyzing cross-media results on all European campaigns</strong>&nbsp;for our luxury sector client.</p> <p>This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, advanced analytical prowess, and strong collaborative skills to evaluate multi-channel performance, ensure consistent brand adherence across European markets, and drive knowledge sharing across international teams. You will play a key role in measuring media efficiency, driving brand visibility, and optimizing customer acquisition across all media channels in Europe.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>European Campaign Planning &amp; Execution:</strong>&nbsp;Assist in the planning, coordination, and execution of regional digital acquisition campaigns (Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, Programmatic, etc.) across European markets, ensuring strict alignment with the client's global strategy and European brand guidelines.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Media Analytics &amp; Performance Reporting:</strong>&nbsp;Lead the comprehensive analysis and evaluation of&nbsp;<strong>cross-media results across all European campaigns</strong>&nbsp;(combining digital, offline, print, broadcast, and programmatic channels). Identify cross-channel synergies, key trends, and actionable data insights to maximize overall media ROI across the region.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Market Collaboration &amp; Knowledge Sharing:</strong>&nbsp;Actively liaise with local European market teams to facilitate the exchange of performance insights, cross-media learnings, and best practices, fostering a connected and high-performing European network. Data Skills:</strong>&nbsp;Advanced ability to work with complex numerical datasets, analyze cross-media campaign performance, isolate channel impact, and distill complex data into clear, strategic recommendations.</li> <li><strong>Project Management:</strong>&nbsp;Capable of managing multiple European campaigns and analytics projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li><strong>Interpersonal &amp; Communication:</strong>&nbsp;Dynamic with excellent communication and client service skills, capable of collaborating effectively across multi-cultural European teams and senior stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Problem-Solving &amp; Innovation:</strong>&nbsp;Proactive approach to identifying performance bottlenecks and an aptitude for leveraging media data to propose innovative cross-channel solutions.</li> <li><strong>Attitude:</strong>&nbsp;Enthusiastic, with a strong willingness to learn, adapt, and drive growth in the luxury sector.</li> <li><strong>Core Values:</strong>&nbsp;Exhibits strong team spirit, thoroughness, and attention to detail in all tasks.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media and its Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our commitment to shaping the future of media is manifested by active support for the professional development of our talents, helping them reach their full potential. This approach is accompanied by a responsible vision in our media investment strategies, thus reflecting our dual priority: valuing our employees while adopting sustainable practices in our sector. WPP Media employees have privileged access to WPP Media's and WPP's international networks, allowing them to develop their passions, expand their professional network, and stay at the forefront of innovations in marketing and advertising.</p> <p>We have vast and varied resources available to our employees; our company actively cultivates the inclusion of talents from all backgrounds. The successes and expertise of the teams are regularly highlighted during unifying events that also punctuate key moments of the year, thus strengthening our collaborative and diverse corporate culture.</p> <p><strong>Our benefits include:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Remote work:</strong>&nbsp;up to 2 days per week and 2 full weeks to be taken twice a year.</li> <li><strong>Two additional days off offered</strong>, including Whit Monday.</li> <li><strong>Additional leave days</strong>&nbsp;based on seniority in 5-year increments.</li> <li><strong>5 additional remote work days per month</strong>&nbsp;for employees suffering from endometriosis.</li> <li><strong>Disability policy:</strong>&nbsp;3 paid authorized absence days per year, access to Chèques Emploi Service Universel (CESU), and specific support for employees with a RQTH (Recognition of Disabled Worker Status).</li> <li><strong>Solidarity missions</strong>&nbsp;possible via the "We care and we act" program.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Recruitment Process</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Interview with the recruitment team:</strong>&nbsp;A first phone or video conference interview with a member of our recruitment team to review your background, discuss your experience with European campaign management and analytics, and address your questions.</li> <li><strong>Operational interview:</strong>&nbsp;An interview with the Luxury Client Team lead to assess your technical, analytical, and management skills.</li> <li><strong>Case study:</strong>&nbsp;A practical case study focused on cross-media campaign analysis and strategy within the European market, followed by a debriefing session.</li> </ol> <p>We are committed to making this process as fast and efficient as possible, and to maintaining open and transparent communication throughout.</p> <p><em>WPP Media guarantees equal opportunities and considers all candidates without discrimination or consideration of particular characteristics. We are committed to cultivating an environment of respect where everyone feels at home and benefits from the same opportunities for professional development.</em></p> <p><em>Consult our privacy policy to learn all about the protection of your data. Although we review all applications received, we only contact those selected for an interview.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic SDLC - (EMEA Only)</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.</p> <p>You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.</p> <h2><strong>Why this role exists</strong></h2> <p>Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.</p> <p>Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Product contribution</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.</li> <li>Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.</li> <li>Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.</li> <li>Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Strategic technical stewardship</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.</li> <li>Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.</li> <li>Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.</li> <li>Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.</li> <li>Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.</li> <li>Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.</li> <li>Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Thought leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.</li> <li>Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.</li> <li>Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.</li> <li>Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.</li> <li>Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.</li> <li>Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.</li> <li>Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.</li> <li>Experience working with Self-Managed.</li> <li>Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.</li> <li>Deep familiarity with Git Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.</p> <h2><strong>Ideal candidate profile</strong></h2> <p>You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ The Product Marketing Manager B2C opportunity

Building the engagement engine with Alan Play that makes 500k members come back to their health every single day, a key differentiator for Alan.

 

Today, 25k Alan members open Alan Play every day (120,000 every month) to walk, meditate, breathe, compete with their colleagues, build healthy habits. Play is Alan's #1 source of traffic and the retention engine of all our health services. And we are B2B2C: companies pay, members choose to engage. Play is a differentiator in deals, and at renewal. HR admins are also an underused distribution channel to reach members. Two audiences, one product story. By 2030 we want 500k daily users, across all our countries

 

The challenges: Our lifecycle is greenfield. Onboarding, activation, reminders, reactivation and win-back are owned by nobody today. We run events rebuilt almost from scratch, so the tenth Alan Cup costs as much as the first. We measure opens and clicks, not what a campaign actually did to daily engagement. And on the B2B side, our pitch goes stale between releases, as Play ships fast, so the sales argument does not keep up.

 

The future: A lifecycle layer designed for personalisation, running on the segmentation and experimentation platform Play has been building. Campaign machinery that gets cheaper every quarter. A measurement loop we trust, with holdouts and real incrementality. A live Play pitch that updates as features ship, so the field walks into a renewal or a deal with the current product. And HR admins turned into a real, measured distribution channel rather than a mailing list.

 

The hard parts: This role is horizontal, and vertical. Many member segments, many admin segments, several countries, coordination with Product as well as Sales, KAM and CSM, as well as other products teams who communicate with members.

 

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

 

Must haves

  • Retention and lifecycle marketing at scale on a consumer product - subscription, gaming, social, media, health and fitness. Where engagement and retention are the business.

  • You build systems, not just campaigns - you can walk us through machinery you built that made the next campaign cheaper, and tell us what it cost you to get it adopted.

  • Analytical rigour - you read a funnel, design a segment, set up a holdout, call a result. You are comfortable being accountable to a product metric.

  • Horizontal operator - you have held many audiences and several countries at once. Volume and context switching, not depth on a single vertical.

  • Genuinely hands on - you want to run the campaigns yourself at the start. This is the ramp up, and the condition for standardising well afterwards.

  • Branding sensitivity : you can express the personality of the product you market and create great moments

  • You write well and fast. Emotion generating copy and branding is a real part of the job

  • Marketing automation at scale - Customer.io, Braze, Iterable or equivalent.

  • Missionary mindset and a real attachment to the health mission.

  • B2B2C sensibility: you can maintain weigh in both segments

 

Nice to haves

  • French, Spanish or Dutch on top of English, for four-country localisation

  • HR tech, employee benefits or workplace wellbeing

  • Gamification, challenges or social mechanics

  • Experience standardising something that other teams then reused

 

Not a fit if

  • You describe success in open and click rates

  • You only want to talk to members, and see commercial side as somebody else's job

  • You need a brief, or someone who writes the strategy for you

  • You want to delegate execution from day one

  • You treat positioning as PMM-only territory, or platform teams as a service desk

  • You are uncomfortable with ambiguity, or need a big team to be effective

     

🙌 Perks & Benefits

Therefore, we offer:

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. raw.description:
Our Mission ⚖️

At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform.

Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard.

Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform.

Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that.

Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities.

Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting.

And we're just getting started.


The context

We’re looking for a senior/fullstack engineer to help us build the first legal intelligence platform.

You’ll join the “Scribe” team with a clear mission: revolutionize legal drafting (Drafting) in France, Italy, and Germany. We deploy cutting-edge solutions (LLMs) directly where lawyers and legal professionals work.

Your roadmap (3–6 months):

  • Web App: Build a multi-document drafting tool and a dedicated chatbot.

  • Integrations: Launch add-ins to assist daily legal drafting.

  • AI & Translation: Enhance our automatic PDF translation features.

Our web tech stack is based on NodeJS, NestJS, React & NextJS.

 
You can find full details about our stack on GitHub https://github.com/DoctrineLegal/#our-tech-stack !
 
Note: Previous professional experience in law is not required, but a willingness to learn and develop expertise in understanding legal documents is important 🙂

Missions 🛠
  • Work closely with product designers and product managers to design the best possible user experiences.
  • Build reusable components used across all our product teams.
  • Develop products at the intersection of Web technologies and Machine Learning.
  • Help disseminate our internal best practices and actively contribute to our Engineering strategy.

    • Ideal Profil 👀
  • Strong command of TypeScript (Node and React).
  • Knowledge in Machine Learning is a plus
  • Strong focus on quality: best practices, testing, CI/CD, reliability and availability.
  • Comfortable working in an agile environment, with a strong product and UX mindset.
  • Enjoys sharing knowledge, collaborating, and giving constructive feedback.
  • Proactive and able to partner with all teams, acting as a driver of positive change.

    • Extras of the role 👁
  • Like all engineers at Doctrine, you will join one of our cross-functional chapters — in this case, the Web chapter. Within this chapter, you will contribute to internal projects aimed at improving our processes and shaping our long-term vision. The chapter meets every week to:

    🌴 A flexible leave policy

    🌱 Real internal mobility opportunities

    🏄‍♂️ Regular team events

    🏋️‍♀️ A Gymlib subscription for sports and wellness activities

title: Product Line Manager
description: About Wallee Group AG Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers. The Role The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy. In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products. The Impact You’ll Make Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes. Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization. Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives. Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis. Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals. Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing). What Success Looks Like Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed. Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk. Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains. Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs. Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches. What You Bring to the Table Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software. Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus. Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis. Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach. Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships. Languages: Fluent in English and German. Why Join Wallee? Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready. raw.title: Product Line Manager
raw.description:
About Wallee Group AG

Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers.

The Role

The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.

In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.

The Impact You’ll Make

  • Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

  • Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization.

  • Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

  • Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

  • Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

  • Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

  • Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

  • Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains.

  • Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs.

  • Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

  • Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus.

  • Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

  • Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German.

Why Join Wallee?

  • Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

  • True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

  • Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.

  • Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation, aligned with experience, seniority, and expertise, personal development budgets, and a social calendar filled with events.

  • The Perks: Fresh fruits, snacks, and high-quality coffee to keep you fueled.

Don’t tick every box? Neither do most great hires. If the role feels right, reach out, we’d love to see if we’re a match.

You will work on solutions ranging from clinical copilots and AI coaching tools to agricultural advisory chatbots and evaluation infrastructure. Design, build, evaluate, deploy, and improve machine learning systems and AI-powered applications for real-world use cases. Contribute to open-source AI evaluation infrastructure and tools that help nonprofit organizations assess and improve their AI products. Work closely with behavioral scientists, researchers, and field teams to identify recurring challenges and translate findings into reusable tools, frameworks, playbooks, and technical publications. Develop rigorous evaluation methods for AI systems, including appropriate datasets, evaluation criteria, and measurable performance improvements. Build and iterate on production-grade LLM applications and agentic systems, improving their reliability, usefulness, and performance for intended users. Release meaningful technical innovations from partner projects as open-source contributions whenever appropriate. Deliver solutions through rapid development and deployment cycles, using experimentation and measurable feedback to guide improvements. Document technical decisions, maintain engineering standards, and ensure AI components remain reliable and maintainable. Monitor developments in applied AI research, assess relevant advances, and test promising approaches in practical settings. raw.title: IoT Embedded Systems Engineer
raw.description:
• Take ownership of the development of IoT systems, with a focus on embedded software, system architecture, and hardware and firmware integration

  • Design and develop robust, efficient, and scalable embedded software for IoT products based on microcontroller platforms and, optionally, Linux based systems

  • Provide technical guidance for hardware development in collaboration with external partners, including reviewing and challenging PCB designs to ensure functionality, quality, and manufacturability

  • Collaborate closely with mechanical, software, and cloud engineering teams to ensure seamless end to end system integration

  • Define and refine product requirements from initial concept through to mass production in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders

  • Develop and integrate prototypes and support the transition from development into serial production together with manufacturing partners

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of the embedded platform, including MCU based solutions as well as optional Linux and Yocto based components

  • Develop pragmatic testing strategies to ensure the functionality, reliability, and quality of both hardware and firmware

  • Support development and manufacturing partners with debugging, technical documentation, and production ramp up

  • Provide Level 3 technical support for complex system, firmware, and hardware related issues

  • Travel approximately 5 to 10 percent to support development partners, product validation activities, and product launches


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

  • Several years of hands on experience in embedded development, including firmware development and hardware related engineering

  • Strong understanding of hardware design and PCB layouts, with the ability to review design decisions and collaborate effectively with hardware development teams

  • Strong expertise in embedded firmware development and software architecture for microcontroller platforms such as ARM Cortex, ESP32, or STM32

  • Experience with sensor integration and wireless communication technologies such as BLE and WiFi

  • Experience with embedded Linux systems, particularly Yocto, is an advantage, especially in environments combining System on Modules with MCU based architectures

  • Broad system level understanding of mechanics, sensors, actuators, and their integration into robust IoT products

  • Hands on experience with hardware testing, debugging tools, and automated production testing

  • Familiarity with certification standards such as CE and FCC is an advantage

  • Fluent in German and English, with additional languages considered a plus

raw.title: Senior Specialist, T2 / Target2 Payment Operations
raw.description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

Senior Specialist, T2 (Target2) Payment Operations 

Location: Remote in Netherlands, Spain, Cyprus or Poland

The role

We’re moving from indirect to direct participation in TARGET2 (T2), and we need someone to own the operational side end to end. You’ll design and document the Payment Operations processes, validate them in the August UAT, cut over BIC by BIC, and then run them as business-as-usual. You’ll be the operational contact for the T2 scheme, DNB and our partner banks.

What you’ll do

  • Own core payment processes: SCT / SCT Inst recalls, investigations (including pacs.028), SWIFT enquiries (MT199/MT999, RFIs), missing or incoming funds, and rejects, returns and refunds.
  • Run the T2 platform day to day: work in the T2 GUI (U2A/A2A), maintain CRDM reference data, and set up four-eyes controls and the manual-vs-automated split.
  • Manage the migration: move traffic from BNP Paribas to direct participation, with every payment traceable by BIC and path, and define when each BNPP-dependent step can be retired.
  • Cover reconciliation and liquidity: be the Payment Ops link to the reconciliation team (funding and defunding stay with Finance Ops/Treasury).
  • Handle incidents and contingency: build the incident process around DNB, FIS and TARGET escalation routes, own Payment Ops’ role in DNB reporting, and define the ECONS II contingency approach.
  • Coordinate with others: work with the Eurosystem, DNB, SWIFT/NEXI, FIS and correspondent banks, and partner with Product and Engineering to specify how the platform should behave.

What success looks like

  • Every direct-participation process has an owner, documented procedures, and passing UAT evidence.
  • The migration causes no impact on customers, and Customer Support has clear guidance.
  • After go-live, T2 runs as stable BAU with no remaining BNPP operational dependency.

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on experience with T2 / TARGET Services (RTGS, TIPS), including the GUI and U2A/A2A actions
  • Around 2-3+ years in payment operations at a bank, EMI or PSP, ideally with SEPA schemes (SCT, SCT Inst)
  • Familiarity with investigations, recalls, returns and SWIFT / ISO 20022 messaging
  • Experience writing SOPs and controls, or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Comfort working with regulators, partners and technical teams
  • Enough ownership to make sign-off and escalation decisions with support from the team
  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • Experience with CRDM reference-data maintenance
  • Involvement in a direct-participation onboarding or sponsor-bank migration
  • Knowledge of DNB / TARGET-NL conditions, IPR, PSD2, or ECONS II contingency processes
What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

If you're energized by working at the intersection of great mobile engineering and real product impact — this is the role.

  • Design and build new features for our Android application, used daily by business owners across Europe.
  • Architect and implement reliable, intuitive solutions for:
  • Multi-account cash flow management
  • Banking transactions and payments
  • Physical and virtual card issuance, activation, and control
  • AI-powered accounting automation
  • Build polished, responsive UIs using Jetpack Compose.
  • Take ownership of code quality, performance, and stability — automated testing and thorough code reviews are non-negotiable.
  • Collaborate closely with Backend, QA, Design, and Product — you'll be shaping solutions end-to-end, not just implementing specs.
  • Drive technical decisions within your domain, challenge assumptions when needed, and proactively identify opportunities to build better.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

    • Who You Are

    You're pragmatic and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. You communicate clearly across disciplines and thrive in a cross-functional environment where everyone is solving the same customer problem together.

    Your experience includes:

  • Strong knowledge of Kotlin (Java knowledge is a plus) and 5+ years of commercial Android development.
  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID, and Clean Architecture.

  • Reactive programming & async: RxJava, Kotlin Coroutines / Flow
  • Dependency injection: Dagger 2, Hilt, or Koin
  • Networking: Retrofit
  • Navigation: Cicerone, Jetpack Navigation Component
  • Modern UI: Jetpack Compose
  • Practical experience with Firebase (FCM, Analytics, Crashlytics).
  • Experience with Feature-module architecture in production.
  • Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.
  • A builder's mentality — you care about the product, the users, and the outcomes, not just the code.
  • Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Background in fintech or experience with financial products — you understand the stakes.
  • Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).

  • Published apps on Google Play you're proud of.
  • An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents and LLM tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) — setting up agent environments, writing prompts, skills, and behavioral rules.
  • Experience with AI-powered IDE tools (Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) — including agent mode, rules files configuration, and integrating AI into the daily development workflow.
  • Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.
  • Ability to evaluate and verify AI-generated output — using automated tests, linters, and critical review to catch hallucinations and errors.
  • Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

Je onderhoudt en versterkt duurzame relaties met onze belangrijkste leveranciers en blijft op de hoogte van nieuwe, opkomende spelers. Je neemt het voortouw in de leveranciersselectie en het contracteringsproces. Hierbij zorg je niet alleen voor de beste commerciële voorwaarden, maar waarborg je ook dat alle afspraken voldoen aan de actuele wet- en regelgeving en onze langetermijnstrategie. Naast inkoop ben je de drijvende kracht achter ons contractmanagement. Je beheert het contractregister waardoor we tijdig kunnen besluiten te verlengen of juist over te stappen naar een andere leverancier. A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events. What do you bring to the table? Vanuit Klundert bouw je aan nieuwe proposities en creëer je kansen binnen uiteenlopende sectoren. Een vacature voor een gedreven commerciële professional die graag pioniert en klantbehoeften achterhaalt. Maak het verschil als Business Development Manager in Nederland Dankzij jouw marktkennis, inzicht en commerciële nieuwsgierigheid ontdekt Adapteo nieuwe groeimogelijkheden en vertaalt de organisatie maatschappelijke en economische ontwikkelingen naar concrete business. Je onderzoekt markten, identificeert kansrijke klantsegmenten en gaat actief in gesprek met bestaande en potentiële klanten en beslissers. Vervolgens vertaal je inzichten samen met accountmanagers, marketing, product development en andere interne collega’s naar proposities, campagnes en een gerichte marktbenadering. Je kwalificeert opportunities en ondersteunt bij grote of complexe klanttrajecten. De rol is landelijk en bestaat indicatief voor 60% uit binnenwerk en 40% uit activiteiten in de markt. Zo combineer je analyse en strategie met persoonlijk contact en commerciële actie. Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het: analyseren van marktontwikkelingen en identificeren van nieuwe sectoren, klantsegmenten en commerciële kansen; ontwikkelen van concepten, proposities, campagnes en marktbenaderingen; initiëren van gesprekken met bestaande en potentiële klanten en relevante beslissers; kwalificeren, structureren en overdragen van business opportunities aan Accountmanagers; delen van marktinzichten en trainen van het salesteam rondom commerciële concepten of aanpak van bepaalde afzetmarkten. Als enthousiaste Business Development Manager kun jij rekenen op: Veel eigenaarschap binnen een organisatie met Europese groeiambities. Je krijgt ruimte om te pionieren, ideeën te ontwikkelen en jezelf en de organisatie verder te ontwikkelen. Vanuit deze positie kun je doorgroeien richting operationele aansturing, een rol als branchespecialist of mogelijk een internationale functie. Voor deze vacature neem jij mee: Je bent nieuwsgierig naar markten en mensen en stelt vragen waarmee je de werkelijke behoefte boven tafel krijgt. Je combineert analytisch en conceptueel denkvermogen met sterke relationele vaardigheden. Dankzij jouw structuur houd je meerdere opportunities en campagnes tegelijk overzichtelijk. Je neemt initiatief, brengt ideeën in en weet marktinformatie terug te brengen tot een concrete commerciële aanpak. Vink jij deze checklist ook af? hbo werk- en denkniveau; minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een commerciële rol en consultative selling; ervaring met projectmatige trajecten; analytisch sterk, waardoor je kansen en prioriteiten goed kunt monitoren; behoeften en wensen vertalen naar conceptuele oplossingen; ervaring met het onderzoeken en opbouwen van nieuwe marktsegmenten; uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Jouw werkgebied Jouw standplaats is Klundert en vanuit daar richt je je op kansen door heel Nederland. Je verdeelt je tijd tussen kantoor, thuiswerken en afspraken bij (potentiële) klanten. Regelmatig reizen binnen Nederland hoort daardoor bij de baan en incidenteel kan een internationale reis voorkomen. Adapteo zoekt bij voorkeur iemand die binnen circa 50 kilometer van Klundert woont. title: Physician Assistant of Verpleegkundig Specialist
description: Wat ga je doen? Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. Je stelt zelfstandig diagnose- en behandelplannen op, verricht risicostratificatie en begeleidt patiënten met uiteenlopende, complexe cardiologische beelden, zoals: Pijn op de borst (angina pectoris) en ischemische hartziekten; Hartritmestoornissen (o.a. atriumfibrilleren); Hartfalen, hypertensie en hypercholesterolemie; Hartkleplijden. Je combineert medisch-technische zorg met leefstijlgeneeskunde en langdurige opvolging. Waar nodig spar je op gelijkwaardige basis met de aanwezige cardiologen; de lijnen zijn bij ons kort en de sfeer is collegiaal. En omdat de inzet van een PA of VS bij onze locatie in Dokkum nieuw is, bieden we een kans: jij bouwt actief mee aan de vormgeving van deze rol en de polikliniek. Jouw visie, klinische blik en initiatief zijn hierin leidend. De locatie in Dokkum is gevestigd binnen het Sionsberg Netwerk Ziekenhuis. Je komt te werken in een toegankelijk en informeel team, waarin we echt voor elkaar klaarstaan. Bovendien biedt het werken in Dokkum rust en ruimte: gratis parkeren voor de deur, geen files en een prachtige omgeving. Bij CCN denken we mee over jouw ontwikkeling. Mocht jij jouw werk bijvoorbeeld op de cardiologie willen afwisselen met ervaring binnen bijvoorbeeld de traumatologie. Dan is dit zeker bespreekbaar na de opstart van deze nieuwe rol binnen onze poli cardiologie. Over ons: onze zorg klopt! We zijn een organisatie van zelfstandige behandelcentra voor hart- en vaatziekten die zich onderscheidt door poliklinische zorg perfect af te stemmen op de behoeften van de patiënt en de verwijzer. We geloven in de kracht van complete zorg onder één dak. Onze patiënten kunnen dicht bij huis terecht voor de meest hoogwaardige cardiologische zorg, en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We werken met geavanceerde hartritme-analyses (holtermonitoring), begeleiden patiënten op afstand via ons innovatieve e-health programma Hartwacht, en voeren poliklinisch elektrische cardioversies (ECV’s) uit. Met een eigen PM-technicus én een eigen spoedpolikliniek in huis is de dynamiek hoog. Daarnaast beschikken we binnenkort over onze eigen CT coronairen. Met deze modernste apparatuur brengen we lokaal, snel en non-invasief de kransslagaders in beeld, een fantastische kwaliteitsimpuls voor jouw diagnostische werk. Wie ben jij? Je hebt de Master Physician Assistant (MPA) óf Master Advanced Nursing Practice (MANP) afgerond en beschikt over een geldige BIG-registratie; Je hebt aantoonbare klinische ervaring binnen de cardiologie (of een zeer sterke affiniteit om je hier in te verdiepen); Je bent communicatief sterk, werkt graag autonoom en zoekt de samenwerking op. Wat bieden we jou? Bij CCN krijg je een salaris conform CAO Zelfstandige Klinieken Nederland (ZKN), een fulltime dienstverband bestaat uit een 40-urige werkweek. De CAO zorgt voor een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden. We willen het beste voor jou, het team en de patiënt. Wij bieden je onder andere het volgende: Een salaris tussen €5.295,- tot €7.901,- conform FWG 65 (cao ZKN) o.b.v. 40 uur per week. We schalen je in op basis van jouw ervaring; Vakantiegeld (8,33%), een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% en deelname aan de pensioenregeling bij PFZW; Een jaarcontract voor 16-32 uur per week, met duidelijke intentie op een volgend contract voor onbepaalde tijd; Een gezonde werk-privébalans: wij bieden uitsluitend regelmaat. Je draait dus géén diensten in de weekenden of avond/nacht; 160 uur vakantieverlof en 72 PLB-uren o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband; Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23/km (er zijn parkeermogelijkheden bij deze locatie) of een NS business card voor woon-werkverkeer; Vakinhoudelijke en professionele ontwikkeling met onze interne klinische lessen en andere opleidingsmogelijkheden. We denken hierbij graag met je mee wat bij jou past; Extra secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals deelname aan onze fietsregeling, zodat je met belastingvoordeel een nieuwe fiets kan kopen. En voordeel op jouw ziektekostenverzekering met onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij IZZ of Zilveren Kruis Achmea. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Een fulltime of parttime baan bij een duurzame, innovatieve werkgever waar jouw advies zichtbaar impact heeft. Taken Maak het verschil als HR Business Partner in Zwolle Dankzij jouw brede HR-expertise krijgen leidinggevenden een stevige sparringpartner en ontwikkelt HR mee met de ambities van de organisatie. Als HR Business Partner adviseer je zelfstandig jouw klantgroepen over strategische, tactische én operationele HR-vraagstukken. Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen organisatieontwikkeling, verandertrajecten en concrete personeelscasuïstiek. Daarbij kijk je kritisch naar bestaande processen en vertaal je ideeën naar concrete verbeteringen. Je werkt nauw samen met de HR Manager en andere HR-collega’s en hebt veel contact met leidinggevenden binnen onder meer Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf en Mooij Verf. Ook zet je HR en financiële data gericht in om keuzes te onderbouwen en pak je zelfstandig projecten op rondom thema’s als Strategische personeelsinzet, medewerker ontwikkeling, duurzame inzetbaarheid en organisatie- en teamontwikkeling. Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het: adviseren en ondersteunen van leidinggevenden bij strategische, tactische en operationele HR-vraagstukken; begeleiden van organisatieontwikkeling en verandertrajecten; zelfstandig initiëren en realiseren van HR-projecten rondom onder andere strategische HR, ontwikkeling en duurzame inzetbaarheid; analyseren van HR-data en vertalen van inzichten naar concrete adviezen en verbeteringen; professionaliseren van HR-processen en versterken van de brede inzetbaarheid binnen het HR-team. Vereisten Voor deze vacature neem jij mee: Je combineert gevoel voor wat belangrijk is voor de organisatie met de durf om stelling te nemen. Daardoor weet je wanneer je moet luisteren, doorvragen of duidelijk positie moet innemen. Je voelt je thuis in een ondernemende omgeving en krijgt energie van het daadwerkelijk realiseren van verbeteringen. Jouw werkgebied Jouw nieuwe werkplek bevindt zich bij Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf in Zwolle. Vanuit deze locatie ondersteunt HR de volledige organisatie, waaronder ook de vestigingen van Mooij Verf in het land. Het kantoor is goed bereikbaar via de A28 en vanuit plaatsen als Kampen, Meppel, Apeldoorn, Deventer en Raalte. Bij een fulltime werkweek is thuiswerken mogelijk. Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf geeft je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, ideeën om te zetten in resultaat en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een organisatie met korte lijnen. Werken bij Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf is een zelfstandig familiebedrijf met ongeveer 220 medewerkers. Vanuit Zwolle ontwikkelt en produceert de organisatie hoogwaardige verfproducten, met duurzaamheid en innovatie als belangrijke pijlers. title: Netwerk Engineer Telecom
description: Over Maxitel Bij Maxitel geloven ze dat zakelijke communicatie meer is dan alleen telefonie. Zij helpen organisaties met slimme oplossingen op het gebied van VoIP, mobiele telefonie, internet, glasvezel, IoT en connectiviteit. Daarbij leveren ze geen standaardproducten, maar maatwerk dat past bij de manier waarop hun klanten werken. Omdat Maxitel groeit en grotere klanten en projecten binnenhaalt, zoeken ze een Network Engineer die dit netwerk mee beheert en verder bouwt. Taken Wat ga je doen? Als Network Engineer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de techniek achter de diensten van Maxitel. Je werkt vanaf kantoor in Alphen aan den Rijn, nauw samen met de senior netwerkspecialist. Geen dag is hetzelfde. Jouw werkzaamheden zijn onder andere: Beheren, configureren en uitbreiden van coreswitches en routers. Onderhouden van het ringnetwerk en bewaken van de redundantie. Aanvragen, inregelen en beheren van glasvezelverbindingen, in afstemming met leveranciers. Inrichten en beheren van datacenterkoppelingen en peering, in afstemming met datacenters en partners. Oplossen van storingen tot op de bodem, inclusief een structurele oplossing. Meedenken over de architectuur van het netwerk nu Maxitel doorgroeit. Documenteren van configuraties en netwerkschema's. Oppakken van andere technische vraagstukken die op je pad komen, samen met collega's van support en sales. Vereisten Wie zoeken wij? Maxitel zoekt een ervaren netwerkengineer die het netwerk echt begrijpt. Niet alleen hoe je iets instelt, maar ook waarom het werkt zoals het werkt. Je hebt dit al een aantal jaren gedaan en werkt zelfstandig. Wie een netwerk goed doorgrondt, pakt ook andere technische zaken makkelijk op. Die brede instelling zoeken ze. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende: Je hebt hbo werk en denkniveau. Je hebt een aantal jaren ervaring als netwerkengineer, bij voorkeur bij een ISP, telecombedrijf of datacenter. Je hebt stevige kennis van routing en switching: BGP, OSPF, VLAN's en bij voorkeur MPLS. Je kent redundante netwerkontwerpen zoals ringtopologieën. Je hebt ervaring met het configureren van apparatuur van bijvoorbeeld Cisco of Juniper. Een certificering zoals CCNA, CCNP of JNCIA is mooi meegenomen. Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en kunt de techniek overnemen als dat nodig is. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend. Engels is mooi meegenomen. Benefits Wat krijg je ervoor terug? Bij Maxitel kom je terecht in een klein en betrokken team waar iedereen elkaar kent. Er zijn geen ingewikkelde managementlagen, waardoor je veel vrijheid krijgt om mee te denken en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Je kunt rekenen op: Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring. Een sleutelrol in een eigen netwerk, met directe impact. Veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Een informeel team met korte lijnen. Opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringen die aansluiten op jouw ambities. Laptop en telefoon van de zaak. Re i Enthousiast? title: Adviseur Loopbaan en Mobilteit Zuid NL
description: Als je goed zorgt voor je mensen, zorgen zij goed voor jou. Deze overtuiging van de oprichter van ADG Dienstengroep vormt de basis van Koersmakers. Koersmakers is een nieuw bedrijf dat werkt aan duurzame inzetbaarheid voor vakmensen, zodat zij maximale regie krijgen over het (werkende) leven. Om dit goed in de praktijk te brengen zijn we op zoek naar een adviseur in de regio Zuid Nederland Omschrijving van het team Koersmakers is een jong, maar groeiend team van 9 collega’s. De mobiliteitsadviseurs Annemiek, Celine, Wilco, Miranda, Mariëlle, Dana en Inez, begeleiden ieder in hun eigen regio vakmensen in verschillende trajecten: van spoor 2 re-integratie tot (loopbaan)coaching en van gespreksbegeleiding tot leiderschapstrainingen. Zwaantje ondersteunt hen in de dagelijkse operatie en Sterre is kwartiermaker en eindverantwoordelijk voor Koersmakers. Taken Wat ga je doen? Als adviseur ga jij in de verschillende trajecten de verhalen, doelen en talenten van hun vakmensen naar boven halen. Op dit moment begeleid je hoofdzakelijk medewerkers in een Spoor 2 re-integratie traject. Tegelijkertijd worden we inmiddels ook steeds vaker gevraagd om vakmensen te begeleiden in (loopbaan)-coaching trajecten en bij gespreksbegeleiding. En die beweging naar preventieve dienstverlening omtrent de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen is precies de stap die ze de komende tijd samen met jou willen zetten. In de begeleiding van vakmensen maak je gebruik van passende (interesse)testen, waaronder de Predictive Index. Jij zet vervolgens dat wat iemand wil, drijft en kan, om naar concrete acties om de inzetbaarheid van deze vakmensen te vergroten en behouden. Hierbij houd je rekening met de actuele regels tot Wet Verbetering Poortwachter en de verzuimcyclus van het UWV. Daarnaast ondersteun je de leidinggevenden van de verschillende ADG bedrijven hoe zij samen met hen de regie van vakmensen op het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk kunnen brengen. Ze vinden het geen probleem als je geen tot weinig ervaring hebt met het gebruik van onze testen. Vereisten Wat ze wel belangrijk vinden: Je hebt ervaring met het uitvoeren van Spoor 2 re-integratie trajecten. Je vindt het leuk om te werken aan de duurzame inzetbaarheid van hun medewerkers. Vakmensen die werk doen wat vaak niet gezien wordt, juist als het écht goed gedaan wordt. Schoonmaakmedewerkers, onderhoudsmonteurs, hospitality professionals, BOA’s en zorgmedewerkers. Zij houden Nederland draaiend. Zij doen het voor hén. Jij zorgt dat de uitvoering van hun dienstverlening (in geval van Spoor 2 re-integratie) voldoet aan de eisen die de verzuimcyclus en de Wet Verbetering Poortwachter stelt. Je legt makkelijk contact met andere mensen, ook in onbekende situaties. Je toont interesse in wie zij zijn en kunt een leidende en sturende rol goed afwisselen met een luisterende en afwachtende rol. Je werkt zelfstandig, beschikt over probleemoplossend vermogen en neemt regie over de trajecten die je begeleidt. Je schakelt gemakkelijk met verschillende gesprekspartners en vertaalt doelen naar concrete stappen, ook wanneer de situatie nog niet volledig duidelijk is Je werkt gericht toe naar (nieuwe) mogelijkheden voor vakmensen om (weer) inzetbaar te worden en blijven. Je vertaalt doelen en mogelijkheden in concrete afspraken en houdt jezelf, medewerkers en leidinggevenden aan deze afspraken. Jij blijft je, ook bij weerstand of uitdagingen, inspannen om de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen te vergroten of behouden. Je werkt precies en zorgvuldig en signaleert bij onvolledigheden en afwijkingen in de begeleiding of rapportages. Hierbij schroom je niet om te benoemen wat je ziet en hoort, durf je kritische vragen te stellen, altijd met het doel om tot oplossingen en mogelijkheden voor inzetbaarheid te komen en altijd met respect voor de ander. Benefits Dit mag jeverwachten Een maandsalaris van EUR 3500 tot EUR 4500 op basis van 40 uur Een jaarcontract voor 24 tot 40 uur 27 vakantiedagen op basis van 40 uur Een dertiende maand! Opleidingsmogelijkheden, denk bijvoorbeeld aan: o De predictive index practitioner o Of een andere opleiding die bijdraagt aan de doelstelling van Koersmakers: regie over het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk brengen. Een fijne werkplek in Houten of bij een van onze ADG zusjes. Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken. De kans om echt impact te maken en mee te bouwen aan een nieuw bedrijf Over Koersmakers Koersmakers is een startup van ADG. Een Twents familiebedrijf met ruim 11.000 collega’s dat groot is geworden met en dankzij hun vakmensen op de werkvloer. ADG zet zich in voor vakmensen met waardering en ondersteuning. Bij Koersmakers geloven ze in gelijke kansen voor iedereen en in een open organisatie waar iedereen zich prettig voelt. Zij willen dan ook een diverse en inclusieve werkgever zijn. Inclusie zorgt ervoor dat werknemers, ongeacht hun achtergrond, overtuigingen, voorkeuren etc, zich gewaardeerd, gerespecteerd en betrokken voelen. Koersmakers gelooft dat dit leidt tot een creatievere en productievere werksfeer, waar innovatieve ideeën kunnen bloeien, betere besluiten worden genomen en talenten volledig tot hun recht kunnen komen. Enthousiast? Druk op de sollicitatieknop en wij ontvangen graag jouw CV. Wil je even contact om te bepalen of deze functie echt bij je past? Bel dan met Staffplanning via 073-7505000.
